As the week draws to a close, it’s definitely been a long one for Apple’s software engineers. The nightmare started on Tuesday, after a Twitter user disclosed a critical security vulnerability for macOS High Sierra that allowed anyone with physical access to a Mac to gain system administrator privileges without even entering a password. As software bugs go, this one was embarrassing and critical, but Apple managed to fix it less than 24 hours after it was publicly disclosed.
“Security is a top priority for every Apple product, and regrettably we stumbled with this release of macOS,” admitted an Apple spokesperson. “We greatly regret this error and we apologize to all Mac users, both for releasing with this vulnerability and for the concern it has caused. Our customers deserve better. We are auditing our development processes to help prevent this from happening again.”
target:
随着本周接近尾声，对苹果的软件工程师来说，这无疑是漫长的一周。噩梦始于周二：一名 Twitter 用户披露了 macOS High Sierra 的一个严重安全漏洞，任何人只要能够物理接触一台 Mac，甚至无需输入密码，就能获得系统管理员权限。就软件缺陷而言，这个漏洞既令人难堪又极其严重，但苹果在漏洞公开披露后不到 24 小时内就完成了修复。
“安全是每一款苹果产品的首要任务，遗憾的是我们在这次 macOS 发布上出了差错。”苹果发言人承认道，“我们对这一错误深表遗憾，并向所有 Mac 用户致歉，既为发布时带有这一漏洞，也为它造成的担忧。我们的用户理应得到更好的产品。我们正在审查开发流程，以帮助防止此类事件再次发生。”

source: Beginning in the late 90s two new broadband technologies began to become available: cable modems and DSL over phone lines. DSL was a big improvement over dial-up, offering faster speeds, always-on connectivity, the ability to still use your phone line for voice calls, etc. And, keeping with the established regulatory regime for telephone lines, DSL services were also covered by Title II, which meant that multiple ISPs could use the telephone lines. Cable modems, though, were unregulated (and thus ISP service was held exclusively by cable companies).
target: 从20世纪90年代末开始，两种新的宽带技术逐渐面世：电缆调制解调器和通过电话线提供的DSL。DSL相比拨号上网是一大进步：速度更快、可始终在线，还能继续用电话线打语音电话，等等。而且，按照电话线路既有的监管制度，DSL服务也受Title II约束，这意味着多家ISP可以使用电话线路。不过，电缆调制解调器不受监管（因此ISP服务完全由有线电视公司把持）。
